name: rk3576-whisper
description: RK3576: Whisper base on the RKNN encoder at a 10 s window. English matches RK3588 to the digit at this window (11.37% short, 10.44% long); Chinese diverges. Deliberately 10 s rather than 20 s on this board: the 20 s decoder working set took a 7.9 GB no-swap RK3576 into a global OOM that killed an unrelated container, and the CPU ONNX decoder is page-cache resident, so `free` looking healthy before a run says nothing about whether the weights stay resident during one.
